jamie: noticed pcie_dma burst + slab churn on shelf-7 during the midnight batch window. p95 latency up. any quick wins?
sara: likely noisy neighbor from large sparse-training job. PCIe spikes -> NIC qlen increase -> host-level backpressure.
dmitri: Can we apply a transient per-tenant io cap instead of full reroute? soft-reserve + nic shaping could limit collateral.
jamie: logs: [2026-03-24T00:12:10Z] dma=900MB/s tenant=big-train job=jt-77 
ops-bot: suggested action: apply nic-shape rule tenant=big-train -> 600MB/s burst for 30s, backoff 60s
sara: Long term: add 'soft_reserve' API to warmpool so it reserves HBM without doing a hard alloc; avoids preempt races.
dmitri: Action items: jamie -> flip nic-shape canary (us-west-2 rack3), sara -> start soft_reserve proto, ops-bot -> monitor slab_churn_rate and dma_burst_rate.
ops-bot: canary started: nic-shape/tenant-limit -> us-west-2-rack3 (10% hosts)
